entities.name: Syrja Vlora

entities.summary: Syreja Vlora (1860–1940), usually referred to as Syrja Bey Vlora, was an Ottoman Albanian politician, an active figure of the Albanian Declaration of Independence in 1912 and one of the delegates of the Assembly of Vlorë.
